items.q: Where does ultrafiltration take place in the nephron?
items.qAf: Waar vind ultrafiltrasie in die nefron plaas?
items.explain: Blood pressure forces water and small solutes out of the glomerulus into Bowman's capsule.
items.explainAf: Bloeddruk dwing water en klein opgeloste stowwe uit die glomerulus in Bowman se kapsule.

items.q: Which substance is fully reabsorbed in the proximal tubule under normal conditions?
items.qAf: Watter stof word onder normale toestande volledig in die proksimale buisie geherabsorbeer?
items.explain: Glucose is actively reabsorbed so none normally appears in urine.
items.explainAf: Glukose word aktief geherabsorbeer, dus verskyn normaalweg geen in die urine nie.

items.q: Why does the loop of Henle help concentrate urine?
items.qAf: Hoekom help die lus van Henle om urine te konsentreer?
options: It creates a salt gradient in the medulla
optionsAf: Dit skep ’n soutgradiënt in die medulla
items.explain: The salt gradient in the medulla draws water out of the collecting duct.
items.explainAf: Die soutgradiënt in die medulla trek water uit die versamelbuis.

options: the body has too much water
optionsAf: die liggaam te veel water het
items.explain: Dehydration raises blood solute concentration, triggering ADH release from the pituitary.
items.explainAf: Uitdroging verhoog bloed-opgeloste konsentrasie en veroorsaak ADH-vrystelling uit die pituïêre klier.

items.q: ADH acts on the collecting duct to:
items.qAf: ADH werk op die versamelbuis om:
items.explain: ADH makes the collecting duct more permeable to water, producing concentrated urine.
items.explainAf: ADH maak die versamelbuis meer deurlaatbaar vir water, wat gekonsentreerde urine lewer.

items.q: Without ADH, a person would produce:
items.explain: Without ADH the collecting duct stays impermeable to water, so dilute urine is excreted in large volume.
items.explainAf: Sonder ADH bly die versamelbuis ondeurlaatbaar vir water, dus word verdunde urine in groot volume uitgeskei.
